concerns.text: Phase 6 (WYSIATI & Confidence Metrics) contains tasks T051–T056 which implement features (confidence_rating, override_time, WYSIATI gap) that are NOT present in spec.md (FR-004 defines outcome solely as 'belief_rating') or plan.md (which explicitly removed this phase). These tasks have no matching FR/SC/Plan element, representing unapproved scope creep.

Tasks T053, T054, T055 attempt to model 'confidence_rating' and 'override_time' as outcomes. The spec.md (FR-004) and plan.md (Constitution Check VI) strictly define the outcome as 'belief_rating' and prohibit synthetic or unverified outcome variables. No spec requirement exists to measure confidence or override latency.

Task T006 implements 'I-VT or I-DT' logic. While spec.md FR-001 allows 'I-VT or I-DT', the plan.md 'Complexity Tracking' and 'Pipeline Tasks' (T005) explicitly select 'I-VT' as the primary path. The task description lacks the specific fallback mechanism or default preference (I-VT 100ms) mandated by the plan's decision to avoid ambiguity, creating a gap in the implementation plan's specific constraint.

Task T024 states it will apply Holm-Bonferroni correction 'specifically to the three-way interaction term'. Spec.md FR-007 requires correction 'when testing more than one hypothesis' (implying all fixed effects). The task description restricts the correction scope in a way that may violate the spec's requirement for family-wise error rate control across all tested hypotheses.

Task T008a defines a logging config with 'level: INFO' as a default. Spec.md US-1 and US-2 acceptance scenarios require logging specific 'warnings' (e.g., missing coordinates, lexicon switch). The task description does not explicitly mandate that the logger configuration must be adjustable to capture WARNING/ERROR levels, creating a potential gap in audit trail coverage required by the spec.
